_usage: Set MOONCAKE_EXTERNAL_STORE_CONFIG to this file. Only direct, pre-registered buffers are supported. put/put_batch/put_parts and stage_nonlocal are unsupported; use FileStorage for internal staging.
_prototype: One Slice per key; original key is not parsed; offset=0. SDK config should set maxErrorCount=1. Wait returns per-key SDK errors without shutting down the SDK. SDK timeout alone does not prove source access has stopped. Read fallback is not implemented.
